reviews.review_description: Excellent sales person with great communication skills and educated us on solar options.Install was completed on the day and we were impressed with the professionalism of the installDelivered on everything they promised.

Great service and quality. No fuss, do the job attitude. System was installed within 2 weeks of signing the contract and took care of all the paperwork including applying for extended warranties were applicable. I will be talking to them when I decide to add batteries and upgrade to a hybrid system.

We had our solar system installed in 2016. We had heard so many horror stories about poor installations and service from interstate/pop up solar companies. We received a number of quotes from various companies and chose to go with Bill at  Quality Solar NT due to the high level of customer service provided by Bill. Nothing was too difficult for Bill. He came around to our house to discuss the installation and provided a quote on a public holiday as it suited us best. He was very patient with all of our questions and changes to the installation. The installation itself is incredibly neat and tidy. After dealing with quite a few companies, I highly recommend Quality Solar NT. We are saving about $2400 a year in power and should have the system paid off with a few years. Don't waste any more time on paying for electricity, get on to Bill and get it installed!

I had 3 solar quotes the man from Quality Solar was the last quote by this time I was armed with all the questions and this man run rings around all the sales people after charting with him I found he was the owner of Quality Solar we closed the deal with in 7 days the system was on our roof a making power he has contacted twice since to ask how it was all going we installed LG panels with a SMA inverterIf you are looking for solar power in the Darwin area make sure  Quality Solar is 1 of your quotes

I had 3 quotes done( it is hard to get reliable service people here in the NT that will turn up on time and follow through with there promises).I wanted a system that came with a warranty and someone that had been in the industry for some time with prior knowledge of the systems and requirements. I have found Quality Solar to come on time for appointments and followed through with information in a timely manner. I have not had it installed yet but all paperwork has been submitted through the correct channels and is moving along quiet smoothly. I hope installation goes as smoothly as the paperwork .
